capabilities: Render contract notes into draggable card panels
Write checkbox changes back to the matching line in the source note
Aggregate project card notes into a status-column Kanban view
Navigate documents with a sticky top bar and floating section catalog
Register and switch between multiple contract documents in settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README includes a full Chinese-language section and a built-in data-contract manual.
problem: Obsidian's native rendering of long tables, lists, and large note blocks is hard to scan: tables overflow horizontally, hierarchy is unclear, and status markers are not prominent.
summary: Renders Markdown notes into interactive card-based panel views where checkbox changes write back to the source note.
